title: Eyewitness accounts of Nazi nuclear tests

tellings.quote: reaction. And then there's a second eyewitness account of of um what appears to be a nuclear test near the Theian forest

plain: The claim is that near the end of the Second World War, around 1944 and 1945, Nazi Germany carried out what looked like nuclear tests, and that a second eyewitness describes one near the Thuringian Forest in central Germany. The researcher Jason Jorjani, who says he found Hitler's secret UFO program, sums this up himself. He relies on the book Critical Mass and on writers named Plimpton Hydrick and Farrell. If true, Germany would have tested nuclear devices before the American bomb.
